text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On one of my days off, I spot Mejiro
Ardan with a
heap of shopping bags by
her feet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think a short break is in order.
Perhaps
I've purchased too much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, could I trouble you? I would
really
appreciate it. In fact, I've almost
reached my
limit.
choice_data_list: Looks heavy. Want me to help you c...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! You've been a
great help.
Oh, there you are! ♪ Arrrdaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, and you're with a trainer? Hiya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we happened to cross paths a
little earlier. I must have looked quite
tired, considering how
quickly they
offered to help carry my bags.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Many thanks for assisting
Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... May I offer you a drink as a token
of my
gratitude? I'm just about to make
some.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! We're having a party where we
all bring
ingredients for healthy
drinks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Did you bring that whole pile of

ingredients, Ardan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: D-did I bring too much?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You could feed an army with all this!
Why did you
bring so much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I found so many things that I
imagined
the two of you would like, and
I couldn't help
myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've always been quick to get sick, so I
do have
some knowledge when it comes
to nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And I've never had the opportunity to
actually
help my friends with this
knowledge, so I wanted
to be of use...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You have borne a great burden for us. I
rejoice at
your efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You're not especially fond of liver, are
you, Chiyono O? I've brought some
cocoa powder and
mustard spinach for
your iron intake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You remembered that I don't like
liver?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And I have Greek yogurt for you,
Yaeno! ♪ It's low in fat and high in
protein, perfect for your
muscles and
bones.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How is it that you know of my desire to train both my muscles and bones?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... I know more about you than
you could
ever know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... I know more about you than
you could
ever know.
choice_data_list: That just goes to show how much yo...
That just goes to show how much yo...
You really keep close tabs on your...
You really keep close tabs on your...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: L-l-l-love, you say?!
choice_data_list: That just goes to show how much yo...
That just goes to show how much yo...
You really keep close tabs on your...
You really keep close tabs on your...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ Gosh, you're making us all
blush.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've got the perfect idea! Yaeno! How's
about we
think up a mixture for Ardan?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is an excellent idea. Do you have
any
particular preferences, Ardan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of drinks do you like?
Lemony ones?
Creamy? Maybe
something like a sports drink?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, so many to choose from.
Hehe! ♪ Well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the trio have fun making drinks
for each
other.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Love, eh? Ehehe, we feel the same way
too!
Right, Yaeno? ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed! Both of us...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: W-we love you, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, b-but not in a romantic way, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Gwahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki runs away in
embarrassment, and
we find ourselves
racing around looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Rivals... Yes, you're quite right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
S-so you've already figured out what our
weak
points are?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Perhaps I have. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... So you know our strengths and 
weaknesses because we're rivals... If I
were to sum
this up with a proverb,
then...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Keep your friends close, and your rivals
at a
party"! Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... I see?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Chiyono O's puzzling proverb,
Mejiro Ardan tilts her head in confusion.
It looks like everyone's made their
feelings for each other
known.
